sol.label: Last reported active profile
sol.detail: A checkmark identifies Default as the editing profile while the menu footer reports Preview app as active.

sol.label: Outside the diagram
sol.detail: Hovering pin 2 lights up the Back button card. MX Master 4 adds a sixth pin and places Spare button in its own group below the art.

sol.label: Show diagram
sol.detail: The compact list puts Ctrl and W keycaps beside Close tab and keeps Edit buttons at a fixed right edge. The offline list uses button icons and shows No device.

sol.label: Select an action
sol.detail: The side editor frames the thumb buttons with the same number used next to Back button. Copy gets a Draft tag and, after saving, a toast and the updated assignment appear.

sol.label: No matching actions
sol.detail: The Copy query yields one Edit result with two keycaps and a Select affordance. The empty state gives direct options to clear the search or record a shortcut.

sol.label: Switch between two pointer speeds
sol.detail: The editor shows 800 and 1600 DPI inputs alongside sliders, with Current and Next press visible even in the short dialog.

sol.label: Saving an action replaces draft M
sol.detail: The outlined Press a key state becomes a draft M that survives an Actions tab round trip and compact resize. Cancel returns to the old assignment. Saving K updates the card and reopening shows K with Saved. The native capture after restart still shows K.

sol.label: Ignore accidental nudges
sol.detail: Selecting Always ratchet and turning off High-resolution scrolling leaves the two saved values visible with separate instructions for re-enabling them.

sol.label: Saved swipe distance
sol.detail: Four orange arrows and a tap icon identify rows. Turning gestures off mutes the icons and slider but keeps action edits and the 60-count value visible.

sol.label: Add 6 seconds
sol.detail: Numbered cards show priority, with Default marked All other apps. Window picking adds an orange 6s counter and the rename field stays inside the same card. The native result adds a python.exe chip and confirms the addition in a toast.

sol.label: Reported mouse features
sol.detail: The connected state puts Bluetooth and firmware side by side and gives battery and DPI separate tracks. The offline cards keep Edit button mappings available.

sol.label: Copy unnamed IDs
sol.detail: Named features sit above monospaced hexadecimal IDs in a two-column card. The report and unnamed-ID copy buttons remain visible at compact width.

sol.label: Applies after resume
sol.detail: The title bar retains Remapping paused after dismissal. Compact editing says Applies after resume next to Save, and the failure view gives two numbered tray steps.

sol.label: Resume remapping
sol.detail: The Windows menu replaces Pause remapping with Resume remapping. Start with Windows has a checkmark and Quit Mushak sits below a rule.

terra.label: Edit profile
terra.detail: The Default selector opens a menu with Preview app and the last reported active profile.

terra.label: Outside the diagram
terra.detail: Numbered markers connect the mouse artwork to the mapping cards, with an extra Button 0x01FF listed below.

terra.label: Show diagram
terra.detail: The compact list pairs each numbered button with its assignment and an Edit control.

terra.label: Select an action
terra.detail: The editor pairs a cropped thumb-button image with categories, action rows and a persistent save footer.

terra.label: No matching actions
terra.detail: An empty search offers Clear search and Record a keyboard shortcut.

terra.label: Switch pointer speed
terra.detail: Two numeric fields and sliders show 800 and 1600 DPI, with current and next-press values.

terra.label: Record key
terra.detail: The shortcut sequence moves from recording to a draft, saved confirmation and reopened recorded key.

terra.label: SmartShift flick sensitivity
terra.detail: The selected wheel mode has an orange outline and its sensitivity slider shows Level 10 of 50.

terra.label: Minimum swipe distance
terra.detail: Directional arrows align with the five tap and swipe mappings, and the slider shows 60 counts.

terra.label: Pick a window
terra.detail: Profile cards show assigned executables, order controls and a six-second capture prompt.

terra.label: Disconnected
terra.detail: The device page shows a reconnect instruction and an Edit button mappings action.

terra.label: HID++ features
terra.detail: Named feature IDs appear in two columns, with copy controls and a separate unnamed ID block.

terra.label: Remapping paused
terra.detail: A persistent title-bar status accompanies a conflict banner, retry and tray recovery instructions.

terra.label: Pause remapping
terra.detail: The Windows tray menu changes that command to Resume remapping while retaining the checked startup item.

astra.label: Edit profile
astra.detail: The Default dropdown separates the checked editing profile from Last reported active profile. The amber navigation marker and bottom battery card anchor the shell.

astra.label: Outside the diagram
astra.detail: Numbered mouse markers match the adjacent assignments. Hovering Back button highlights marker 2 and its card together. Spare button replaces Button 0x01FF after naming.

astra.label: Show diagram
astra.detail: Compact list rows retain keyboard keycaps and explicit Edit buttons. The diagram alternative keeps numbered markers and card names.

astra.label: Select an action
astra.detail: The Thumb buttons close-up sits beside a category list and action picker. Copy changes to Draft with an enabled Save action, followed by a saved toast.

astra.label: No matching actions
astra.detail: A search for Copy produces a single result with Ctrl and C keycaps. An empty search offers Clear search and Record a keyboard shortcut.

astra.label: Switch between two pointer speeds
astra.detail: Speed 1 and Speed 2 pair numeric DPI inputs with sliders. Current: 1000 DPI and Next press: 800 DPI make the alternating action explicit.

astra.label: Recorded key
astra.detail: The sequence distinguishes Press a key, New shortcut, and Recorded key. The saved K returns with a green Saved label, and modifier buttons show checks in the compact chord.

astra.label: Ignore accidental nudges
astra.detail: Wheel mode uses three radio cards. Disabled sensitivity controls keep their values and explain which setting enables them. Compact frames retain every setting.

astra.label: Minimum swipe distance
astra.detail: Five gesture rows pair directional icons with action keycaps. The 60 counts value is explained as about 1.5 mm at the reported 1000 DPI.

astra.label: Pick a window
astra.detail: The six-second capture state explains when the active app is added and offers Add 6 seconds. A later toast confirms python.exe. Long profile names wrap without covering reorder controls.

astra.label: Reported mouse features
astra.detail: Device status shows Bluetooth, firmware, a 50% battery bar, and a DPI slider. Disconnected and No device states offer Edit button mappings.

astra.label: HID++ features
astra.detail: The diagnostic view names hardware features alongside hexadecimal IDs and separates 18 unnamed features below. Copy device report and Copy unnamed IDs are visible.

astra.label: Couldn't save assignment
astra.detail: Save failure explicitly says Copy is still unsaved and the previous assignment remains active. Paused editors say Applies after resume. Resume failure provides two numbered tray steps.

astra.label: Resume remapping
astra.detail: The native menu replaces Pause remapping with Resume remapping while Start with Windows retains its checkmark. Separators isolate settings and quitting.
